### New

* **The calibre backup plugin now works over Wi-Fi.** If your Kindle is connected to calibre through [Calibre Wireless](https://github.com/dq-stack/CalibreWireless) (1.1.0 or newer), InkSights Backup now saves each book's reading data and the InkSights reading log, the same as over USB. Before, it said "Connect your Kindle first". With an older Calibre Wireless it tells you to update instead.

### Downloads

* `inksights-1.1.0.zip`: the Kindle app (unchanged apart from the version)
* `inksights-backup-calibre-1.1.0.zip`: the calibre backup plugin

### Upgrading

Install the new plugin zip in calibre (Preferences > Plugins > Load plugin from file) and restart calibre. The Kindle app doesn't need updating.
